newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank BII to up stakes in two banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank BII to up stakes in two banks.

text.p: Indonesia's Bank International Indonesia (BII), a member of the Sinar Mas Group, said on Wednesday it planned to increase its stake in two joint venture banks but was awaiting central bank approval.

In an announcement to the stock exchange, BII said it will add to its equity in Fuji Bank International Indonesia (FBII), a venture with Fuji Bank, and Bank Credit Lyonnais Indonesia (BCLI), a unit of Credit Lyonnais.

"Bank BII will increase the current equity of 15 percent to 20 percent in FBII. For the additional shares, BII will pay 18.8 billion rupiah," the statement said, adding that Fuji Bank will dilute its stake to 80 percent from 85 percent.

The statement also said BII will pay 8.9 billion rupiah to increase its equity to 20 percent in BCLI, but it did not give details of current holdings and who the additional stake would be bought from.
